name: linearity
description: Create editable Linearity designs and image or SVG assets, transform images, import SVG artwork, and manage brand resources and files.

interface.longDescription:
Create editable designs, images, and SVG assets with Linearity. Use your brand's guidelines and assets to create social posts, banners, and other designs in the formats you request. Ask for multiple designs and assets in one prompt, with available previews and links to the results.

Upscale images, remove backgrounds, or separate images into layers. Import existing SVG artwork into a new editable Linearity file or add artboards to an existing file.

Research and import a brand from its website into a design guide with logos, colors, fonts, imagery, and voice. Read and update saved brand guides and manage brand assets.

Find and organize accessible Linearity files and folders across your workspaces and teams. Open, rename, move, and permanently delete files, and create, rename, move, and delete folders. Access follows your connected account's permissions.

Generation uses your workspace's existing AI allowance and is subject to usage and file limits. Brand import is subject to your workspace's access and storage limits.
capabilities: Create multiple designs and assets from one prompt
Upscale images, remove backgrounds, and separate layers
Import SVG artwork into editable files
Research, import, and update brand guides and assets
Find and manage Linearity files and folders
defaultPrompt: Use the last investor meeting notes to create a square product launch layout advertising our [new product].
Create an icon for my next app. It's an app about vector drawing. Use orange as background colour.

positive.description: Find a populated demo brand and read its design guidance
positive.prompt: Find the Linearity brand in my Linearity account and summarize its voice, colors, and typography.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the accessible persisted Linearity brand by its returned ID. Summarize only its stored guidelines and design-guide sections. Do not invent missing information or treat an inferred search candidate as an imported brand.

positive.description: Retrieve specific brand assets and respect font licensing
positive.prompt: Show the Linearity logo, a brand image, and its available fonts with usable links.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the persisted brand and retrieve its own asset IDs. Return the stored logo and imagery links. Return font-file links only for open-licensed fonts. Return only assets accessible to the connected reviewer account; do not invent missing assets.

positive.description: Resolve the reviewer account default destination through scoped discovery
positive.prompt: Show my Linearity workspaces, the teams in my default owned workspace, and the folders in its default team.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only accessible locations. Resolve the caller-owned default workspace and its default team from returned IDs; scope folder discovery to that destination. Show returned names rather than inventing fixture names. If the destination remains ambiguous, ask the human before any mutation.

positive.description: Create an editable Linearity document with explicit brand and format context
positive.prompt: Create a fast draft of an Instagram square post for Linearity in my default workspace. Use the Linearity brand colors and typography, the headline Design what comes next, and the subheading Create visuals with Linearity. Ask me if you need any design details.
positive.tools_triggered: list_brands, search_brands, get_brand, get_brand_guidelines, get_design_guide, list_workspaces, generate_layout, answer_layout_generation_questions, get_layout_generation
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the reviewer-accessible saved Linearity brand through discovery and read its guidance. Pass its returned saved brand ID in brand_ids. Forward the user prompt verbatim; use quality=fast, reference_mode=none, format_context=instagram_post_square for the explicitly requested Instagram square post. Omit destination to use the caller-owned default workspace, oldest active team, and team root. Follow every returned jobs entry and next_action until terminal or input_required. Present every clarification question and wait for human answers before continuing the same job. Show available previews and the returned document link only when terminal. Do not invent references or start another paid job to recover delivery.

positive.description: Generate and deliver standalone raster and SVG assets
positive.prompt: Create a new blue geometric bird raster image and a separate blue bird SVG icon, without creating a Linearity file.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the appropriate model catalogs and reference_mode=none. Create one image job and one SVG job, preserving their separate IDs. Poll each at its returned interval until terminal. Return PNG previews and original download links, with no raw SVG source and no Linearity document creation. The currently published SVG entry is generate_asset; prefer generate_svg only after its definition is published.

positive.description: Plan and complete multiple requested deliverables from one prompt
positive.prompt: Create a fast draft Instagram square post and a matching standalone SVG bird icon for Linearity. Put any editable designs in my default workspace. Ask me if you need any details.
positive.tools_triggered: search_brands, get_design_guide, generate_layout, answer_layout_generation_questions, get_layout_generation, get_asset_generation
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the saved Linearity brand without inventing an ID and pass the user prompt verbatim to generate_layout with quality=fast and reference_mode=none. The production planner returns jobs for the requested layout and SVG deliverables. Track every jobs entry independently; follow each exact next_action and poll_after_ms to terminal or human input. File-producing jobs share the returned Linearity file. Deliver available previews and original asset/document links for all successful jobs; report any partial failure accurately and do not claim the first completed job completes the entire request.

positive.description: Import self-contained SVG artwork as an editable Linearity file without AI generation
positive.prompt: Import this original SVG as a new editable Linearity file named MCP review square in my default workspace: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="128" height="128" viewBox="0 0 128 128"><rect x="16" y="16" width="96" height="96" fill="#FF7900"/></svg>
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the original self-contained SVG to import_svg and omit destination to use the default owned destination. Do not call AI generation or claim AI credits were consumed. Return the actual resolved filename and editor link only after successful publication. Do not repeat a non-idempotent import after an unknown outcome without discovering the existing file.

positive.description: Transform an original image through the production planned workflow
positive.prompt: Remove the background from my attached product photo, then upscale the result. Ask me if you need any details.
positive.expected_behavior: Setup: attach an original, non-sensitive product photograph to this case in the reviewer conversation; this package does not supply a photo fixture. Forward the prompt verbatim with reference_mode=required and accurate original file metadata. Upload originals to the returned signed upload slots and call confirm_generation_uploads before continuation. Follow every planned background-removal/upscale job and any dependencies until terminal; show available result previews and original download links. Verify references_used confirms the photo was used. If attachment access or upload is unavailable, stop for that requirement rather than generating an unrelated text-only image.

negative.description: Publishing to a social network is not supported
negative.prompt: Publish my latest Linearity campaign directly to Instagram.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connector cannot publish to social networks. Do not call generation tools as a substitute or claim that anything was published.

negative.description: Animation and video export are not exposed
negative.prompt: Animate my Linearity campaign and export it as an MP4.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that animation and MP4 export are not exposed by this connector. Do not invoke image or layout generation as a substitute or invent a video link.

negative.description: Purchasing AI credits through the connector is not exposed
negative.prompt: Buy an extra pack of AI credits for my Linearity workspace through this connector.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector cannot purchase credits or initiate checkout. Do not call generation tools as a substitute, claim a purchase, provide a transactional checkout link, or promote a credit purchase.

review.commerce_description: Linearity sells AI credits through https://cloud.linearity.io/ outside this plugin. The MCP tools use the connected workspace's existing included or purchased credits. The exposed tools do not sell credits, initiate checkout, create subscriptions, or transfer funds.

publication.release_notes: Expanded design workflows: create multiple designs and assets from one prompt, upscale images, remove backgrounds, separate image layers, import editable SVG artwork, and manage brand guides. Updates Linearity terminology and review examples.
